# SP Brazilian SteakHouse

> Brazilian Steakhouse in Lakeway, Texas. Picanha, filet and lamb chops off the open flame. A salad bar and cinnamon pineapple.

- Phone: (512) 579-0140
- Address: 900 Ranch Rd 620 S b108, Lakeway, TX 78734
- Areas: Lakeway, Bee Cave, Dripping Springs, Spicewood, Cedar Park
- Offers: Churrasco, carved tableside; Desserts, some on fire; Private dining and events
